exposure: Uterine incisional hematoma following cesarean section
Location of hematoma (intra-incision, intra- and posterior incision, combination of intra-, anterior, and posterior incision, anterior incision plus partial intra-incision)
outcome: Incidence of cesarean section scar diverticulum
cohort: 1,939 women who underwent their first cesarean section between January 2020 and December 2021
finding: Uterine incisional hematoma, particularly when complicated by uterine incisional dehiscence, is significantly associated with an increased risk of developing cesarean section scar diverticulum.
